items.source: Cassandra Query Options for queries. QueryOptions allow tuning of various query options on a per-request level. Only options that are set are applied to queries.
items.translation: Cassandra 查询选项。对于查询，QueryOptions 允许在每次请求级别调整各种查询选项。仅应用的已设置选项会生效于查询。
